verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a payments SaaS like SumUp, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions data residency, storage regions, or any user-selectable hosting location. Offline transactions caching card data on the device is store-and-forward, not a residency choice, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
